name: Protein sequence matches and local sequence features
description: Retrieve exact protein sequences, compare selected homologs or database matches, and expose domain/local-residue differences without converting similarity into substrate, orthology or native-role assignments.

capability_operations.operation: Retrieve a selected sequence or reference page

inputs.query_or_accession: literal UniProt query/accession or selected NCBI protein/nuccore accession

outputs.reference: source-bound sequence, native annotation assertions, features and acquisition metadata

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

capability_operations.operation: Run an explicitly selected sequence comparison

inputs.molecule_mode: Select molecule=protein|dna|rna and mode=local|global using the actual sequence.align schema; these fields do not apply automatically to other callables.

outputs.alignment: native alignment and score with separate operand coordinates
outputs.selected_sites: substitutions, gaps, insertions and unexamined positions

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

capability_operations.operation: Search a selected protein reference collection

inputs.search_model: Choose one advertised callable/program/database combination and its exact schema; HMMER phmmer/hmmscan and BLAST programs do not share one interchangeable parameter set.

outputs.hits: native hit/domain/HSP rows and search identity; not assigned functions

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

capability_operations.operation: Inspect a declared local sequence rule

inputs.rule: explicit motif or position correspondence and coordinate convention

outputs.observations: exact match/nonmatch sites, lengths and gaps; no learned biological specificity rule

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

repository_catalog_defined: gene_annotation_episode/tools.py:catalog definitions for sequence.align/sites, public.uniprot.*, public.ncbi.*, public.hmmer.*, public.blast.*; detached homology.* implementation is separately caller bound
research_operations_performed: sequence/hemk-homology-reference-sequences-20261021.json, hemk-pairwise-comparisons.json and hemk-prmb-proteome-comparison.json: fresh source sequences, motif checks, pairwise comparisons and local proteome score search; no BLAST E-values computed.
capability_specifications_not_confirmed_: A generally registered multiple-sequence-alignment, phylogenetic-tree builder or learned specificity classifier was not confirmed by this catalog inspection.
author_experiments_are_source_evidence_o: Protein substrate screens and variant complementation in the examples are published evidence, not executable operations supplied here.
availability.binding_limit: A repository catalog definition is confirmed source-code identity, not proof of caller enablement, service availability, installed dependencies or execution in this research. Research scripts are retained operations, not registered runtime tools.

limits: A best match, conserved catalytic motif or high global identity does not identify exclusive substrates.
A custom local score search has its actual score model and database scope; do not label its scores BLAST statistics.
Negative complementation is not automatically absence of purified activity.
